first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: gray head-and-chest bust
entities.identification: The dark gray hairless head-and-chest bust in the center of the set, with a long neck and shoulder cross-section, its face angled slightly toward image-left.

entities.name: white two-tier rotating platform
entities.identification: The white, wide, flat, two-tier circular platform below the bust, with a dark gap between the tiers on the near side and a dark circular component on the front of the base.

entities.name: white rectangular backdrop panel
entities.identification: The large bright white rectangular backdrop panel behind the bust, occupying the center-right area.

entities.name: dark gray studio wall
entities.identification: The dark gray background wall surrounding the white rectangular backdrop panel, with low-contrast variations in light and dark across its surface.

entities.name: black foreground camera
entities.identification: The black camera in the lower-left foreground with its back facing the filming viewpoint, featuring a screen flipped downward, a lens, rear controls, and a green indicator light.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person visible only as a black sleeve, a light brown hand, and part of an arm, with the arm entering the foreground from image-left.

entities.name: light-colored textured tabletop
entities.identification: The light gray-white horizontal tabletop supporting the circular platform in the lower part of the image, with gray linear texture on its exposed portions.

entities.name: bar-shaped light fixture at the top
entities.identification: The slender dark bar-shaped main body in front of the upper portion of the backdrop panel, with its right end connected to a light-colored diagonal arm and a dark joint.

entities.name: black light stand on the right
entities.identification: The dark vertical rod-shaped stand on the right side of the backdrop panel, with clamps, horizontal joints, knob-like components, and a cable beside the rod.

entities.name: “REMOTE CONTROL” subtitle graphic
entities.identification: The bold black uppercase text and surrounding thin red line graphic in the lower center-right of the image.
